ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The land-atmosphere system (the atmosphere and the ground) absorbs solar shortwave radiation (energy income), and also emits longwave radiation outward (energy expenditure). The difference between energy income and expenditure is called the radiation balance. The following figure is a monthly distribution chart of the multi-year average radiation balance of a coastal place. Read the figure and answer: <image1> If only the influence of the radiation balance on temperature is considered, in which month is the temperature of this place the lowest?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the horizontal axis is January—December, the vertical axis is radiation balance, and the curve is below the 0 line in January—March, indicating that the radiation balance is negative; it crosses the 0 line near about April and turns positive; afterward, May—July are positive values and rise, reaching a relatively high value around July. Then reason: if only the influence of the radiation balance on temperature is considered, when the radiation balance is negative, there is an energy deficit and temperature will decrease; when the radiation balance is positive, there is an energy surplus and temperature will rise. Therefore, the lowest temperature should appear in the turning month when continuous decline changes to rise, that is, the month when the radiation balance changes from negative to positive; reading the figure, it is about April.

raw_record.question_text:

The difference between energy income and expenditure is called the radiation balance. <image1>

If only the influence of the radiation balance on temperature is considered, in which month is the temperature of this place the lowest?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：读出横轴为1—12月，纵轴为辐射差额；曲线在1—3月位于0线以下，约在4月穿过0线转为正值，随后5—7月为正。再推理：题目要求“只考虑辐射差额对气温的影响”，因此辐射差额为负时气温因能量亏损而下降，为正时气温因能量盈余而上升。气温最低应出现在由持续下降转为上升的月份，即辐射差额由负转正的转折点，读图约为4月。

<image1>

若只考虑辐射差额对气温的影响，该地气温最低的月份是几月？
